rules.rationale: This equation defines the intValue projection helper as the identity on values already of sort Int.
This k-cell rule operationally refines one list-iterator step under isInt, yielding the same element through intValue so integer execution rules can observe its sort.
This macro-style equation defines the named scanBody proof term by expanding it to the exact loop-body statement constructors.
This macro-style equation defines finishBody as the sentinel conversion and return statement sequence.
This equation defines solutionBody by composing the initial assignments, scan loop, and finishBody proof term.
This equation defines the named largestSmallestModule term containing the target function definition.
This is a guarded case of the negStep definition: a negative first candidate replaces the zero sentinel.
This is a guarded case of the negStep definition: a larger negative value replaces a nonzero accumulator.
This is a guarded case of the negStep definition retaining the accumulator for a nonnegative input.
This is a guarded case of the negStep definition retaining a nonzero accumulator when the new negative value is not larger.
This is a guarded case of the posStep definition: a positive first candidate replaces the zero sentinel.
This is a guarded case of the posStep definition: a smaller positive value replaces a nonzero accumulator.
This is a guarded case of the posStep definition retaining the accumulator for a nonpositive input.
This is a guarded case of the posStep definition retaining a nonzero accumulator when the new positive value is not smaller.
This equation defines the empty-sequence base case of the negative-extremum fold.
This guarded recurrence defines the nonempty-sequence case of negFold using negStep.
This equation defines the empty-sequence base case of the positive-extremum fold.
This guarded recurrence defines the nonempty-sequence case of posFold using posStep.
This equation defines finalValue on an empty sequence as the prior loop-variable value.
This guarded recurrence defines finalValue on a nonempty sequence as the final integer element reached by iteration.
This equation defines the empty-sequence base case of the allInts structural predicate.
This recurrence defines allInts on a nonempty sequence by testing the head and recursively testing the tail.
This equation defines optionalNeg at the zero sentinel as the Python None value.
This guarded equation defines optionalNeg for a nonzero integer as that integer.
This equation defines optionalPos at the zero sentinel as the Python None value.
This guarded equation defines optionalPos for a nonzero integer as that integer.
